dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: A refreshing night such as this is perfect for training.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You know, whenever I recall the steps I've taken in the study of swordsmanship, memories of my journeys also flood into my mind.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: As such, no matter where I am... When I hold my blade, I feel as if you are right there with me.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I wouldn't have it any other way. It seems the bamboo blade in my bag will finally see some use.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I've heard many tales about you during my travels. I imagine you've gotten even stronger since we last met in Inazuma.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It just so happens that I, too, have not ceased training. In which case, let the blades in our hands tell of our experiences since our parting.

choices.text: Where do you intend to go next?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I've asked Captain Beidou for leave to go to Natlan.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I'm presently packing my things, in fact... I suppose this feeling of anticipation is itself a part of the journey.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I'm sure we will meet again. We're both people on the road, after all.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: When that time comes, I shall have a bottle of fine wine ready, and we shall share stories once more.
